name: share
description: share — publish an HTML artifact (plan, viz, report) to a shareable link on your own Cloudflare R2 via `agents artifacts share`. `/share` posts a public link with an unfurling OG preview card; `/share --private` posts an unlisted, auto-expiring (`--no-cover --expire 7d`) link with no preview. Requires a one-time `agents artifacts setup`.
